name: agentic-bioflow-positron-bridge
description: Loopback-only HTTP bridge to positron.runtime.executeCode, for an external agent (positron_run.py) to run code in a console Positron already has open. Fixes agentic-bioflow issue #14: kallichore 0.1.68 no longer writes connection files, only a one-shot handshake pipe positron_run.py can never reach.
